name: Westfall Stew
summary: In Westfall, another family is leaving its farm as banditry drives homesteaders from their land. Before departing, Verna Furlbrow entrusts her cherished local recipe to Salma Saldean.

sections.title: A Recipe Passed On
sections.body: Defias thieves and wild mechanical harvest reapers have driven Verna and Farmer Furlbrow from their family acreage. They pack their wagon and prepare to seek refuge behind Stormwind's walls. Before leaving, Verna gives her neighbor Salma Saldean the recipe for Westfall Stew, hoping the farm's home-cooked tradition will live on.

sections.title: Homestead Solidarity
sections.body: Salma Saldean and her husband, Farmer Saldean, still hold their homestead just down the road. Verna's recipe marks the loss of another neighbor to the unrest, yet keeps a local farm tradition alive. Salma sets out to gather the ingredients needed to feed those still struggling on the frontier.

faq.q: Why are the Furlbrows leaving their farm?
faq.answer: Defias thieves and bandits have made the Furlbrows' fields too dangerous to work. Verna and Farmer Furlbrow are packing their wagon to flee to Stormwind City.

Salma Saldean is a Westfall homesteader who lives with her family on Saldean's Farm, just past the fork in the road from the Furlbrow homestead. They keep working their land despite the lawlessness around them.
Westfall Stew is a traditional regional dish made from ingredients found across the Westfall plains, shared among local farming households.

faq.q: Where are the Furlbrows planning to go?
faq.answer: The Furlbrows are heading north to Stormwind City for safety, where Verna's friends believe she will fit right in.
Saldean's Farm lies just beyond the fork in the main road, south of the Furlbrow pumpkin patch in Westfall.

faq.q: Does this quest reward the actual cooking recipe?
aliases: do i get westfall stew recipe
faq.answer: Delivering the written instructions to Salma is only the first step. To prepare the stew, she asks for help gathering the ingredients.

angles.text: Westfall Stew is frontier fare for human homesteaders, made from scavenged prairie game and hardy root vegetables.
As a human, you see the kingdom's rural citizens driven from their ancestral farms into urban exile as the Stormwind frontier crumbles.
